text.aria-label: Subtitle text '16 Primary substations, 292 daily forecast runs, July 2025 to June 2026. Only the 37,394 half-hours (1.3%) whose newest, same-day, or same-week lag falls in a labelled event, in 8 months. Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval from re-drawing whole months. Zero: same score. Read as description: the subset is small and the intervals are not corrected for several comparisons.'
